newsitem.title: USA: Millipore Corp to set $200 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Millipore Corp to set $200 mln in debt.

text.p: Millipore Corp is expected to tap the corporate bond market with a $200 million two-part debt offering as early as Tuesday, dealers said.

The first tranche is expected to consist of $100 million in five-year debt with price talk seen at 55 basis points over U.S. Treasuries. The second tranche is expected to include $100 million in 10-year debt with price talk seen at 75 basis points over Treasuries.
The Baa3/BBB rated deal is expected to be underwriteen by JP Morgan Securities and Credit Suisse First Boston, sources added.
